description:
Get the prepaid balance (in euro cents and mills), the low-balance threshold, the top-up amounts on offer and the auto top-up setting. Proofs past the plan's included amount are drawn from this balance; once billing is live, an account whose balance is at or below zero is refused new proof requests (402 balance_empty) until it tops up. billing_enabled says whether billing is live. Topping up and changing auto top-up are done by the owner in the dashboard.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_balance

outputSchema.description: The prepaid balance, from which proofs past the plan's included amount are drawn

billing_enabled.description: Whether billing is live. While it is off, nothing is drawn from the balance and nothing is paused.

low_balance_threshold.description: The balance in euro cents below which the owner is sent a low-balance notice.

top_up_amounts.description: The top-up amounts on offer, in euros.
